subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: A shape is enlarged by scale factor 1/2. A side of length 8 cm becomes how long?
questions.explain: Lengths multiply by the scale factor: 8 × 1/2 = 4 cm.

questions.q: The point (5, 2) is reflected in the line y = x. What is its image?
questions.explain: Reflecting in y = x swaps the coordinates: (2, 5).

questions.q: Which column vector translates a shape 4 units left and 1 unit up?
questions.explain: Left is negative x and up is positive y, giving (-4, 1).

questions.q: A shape is enlarged by scale factor 3. A side of length 5 cm becomes how long?
questions.explain: Lengths multiply by the scale factor: 5 × 3 = 15 cm.

questions.q: Under a rotation, one point of a shape does not move at all. What does this point represent?
questions.explain: A point that does not move is the centre (invariant point) of the rotation.

questions.q: A shape is enlarged by scale factor 5. Its area is multiplied by what?
questions.explain: Area scales by the square of the scale factor: 5^2 = 25.

questions.q: A point is translated by the column vector (3, -2). The point (1, 5) moves to which point?
Add the column vectors (-4, 7) and (4, -7).
A triangle is rotated 90° anticlockwise about the origin. The point (0, 1) maps to which point?
questions.explain: A 90° anticlockwise rotation about the origin sends (0, 1) to (-1, 0).

questions.q: A square of area 9 cm^2 is enlarged by scale factor 3. What is the new area?
questions.explain: Area multiplies by 3^2 = 9, so 9 × 9 = 81 cm^2.

questions.q: A shape is rotated 180° about the origin. The point (3, 2) maps to which point?
questions.explain: A 180° rotation about the origin negates both coordinates: (-3, -2).

questions.q: A triangle is rotated 90° clockwise about the origin. The point (1, 0) maps to which point?
questions.explain: A 90° clockwise rotation about the origin sends (1, 0) to (0, -1).

questions.q: A shape is reflected in the y-axis. A point lying exactly on the y-axis is described as:
questions.explain: A point on the line of reflection does not move, so it is invariant.

questions.q: The point (-3, 5) is reflected in the line y = x. What is its image?
questions.explain: Reflecting in y = x swaps the coordinates: (5, -3).

questions.q: Which column vector describes a translation of 2 units right and 3 units down?
questions.explain: Right is positive x, down is negative y, giving (2, -3).

questions.q: The point (-2, 3) is translated by the column vector (5, -4). What is its image?
A shape is enlarged by scale factor 2. Its area is multiplied by what?
questions.explain: Area scales by the square of the scale factor: 2^2 = 4.

questions.q: The point (2, 7) is reflected in the y-axis. What is its image?
questions.explain: Reflecting in the y-axis negates the x-coordinate: (-2, 7).

questions.q: What single transformation maps a shape onto its image of the same size but on the opposite side of the y-axis?
questions.explain: Same size on the opposite side of a line describes a reflection in that line.
